newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks rise slightly in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks rise slightly in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices rose slightly in late Tuesday trade, boosted by buying in warrant-eligible shares despite profit-taking in electronics, brokers said.
With 50 minutes to go, at 0310 GMT, the index was up 16.07 points or 0.19 percent at 8,383.53.
Turnover was an active T$99 billion.
Brokers said recently red hot electronic shares were facing a much-needed correction, with several notebook computer makers falling on expected profit cuts.

"Since market liquidity is still loose and electronics are taking a break, investors have begun buying big-capital shares that are qualified for inclusion in the island's debut warrants," said Ting Kong Securities analyst Tsao Chung-ping.
One such company, food giant President Enterprise, jumped T$2.5 or 4.81 percent to T$54.5.
